The '''Garr'lst system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garr'lst]].
